mechanics_notes: Takes reduced damage from unopposed attacks and from Tremor/Rupture/Sinking depending on phase.
At 55% HP, phase transition removes non-exclusive effects and resets Procuration [Hermes].
Oracle Device [Caduceus]: random weapon assigned to every coin; weapon has unique effects.
Using an attack skill gains 1 Procuration [Hermes], max 9.
At 9 Procuration [Hermes], uses a powerful skill and then changes pattern.
Unlock stages occur by Grace of the Prescript thresholds or HP/turn conditionals.
Turn End: if Prescript executed, heal SP and gain Grace; if not, gain Karmic Consequence.
Phase 2 gains stronger status rules and final low-HP Furioso sequence.

raw_lines: id="Behavior">Behavior

For the duration of the fight, Hong Lu will have [My Heart, My Own Thoughts…] My Heart, My Own Thoughts… applied to him. If The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu is on the field, Hong Lu will gain [No Matter How Many Must Bleed...] No Matter How Many Must Bleed... instead.
Ryoshu will have [Mutilated Memory] applied to her.
Attack Pattern
Lei Heng uses multiple different skill rotations based on his remaining HP.
On the first Turn of battle, Lei Heng will inflict a hidden -5 Clash Power penalty to all Sinners, but will unable to bring them below 20% HP. He uses the following Skills:
- Triple Slash, Triple Slash, Double Slash, Double Slash, Double Slash, Double Slash

At the start of the second Turn, a cutscene will play, after which the Durante - Morositas effect will become active for the rest of the fight and all Sinners will be healed to full HP. Lei Heng continues to use the previous Skills.

Below 90% HP or automatically at the end of the second Turn, Lei Heng loads his weapon, recovers from Stagger, and gains 6 [Tigermark Round] at the end of every Turn. He will use the following Skills.
- Blasting Shatterslash [爆碎斬], Triple Slash - Blast [爆], Triple Slash - Blast [爆], Double Slash - Blast [爆], Double Slash - Blast [爆], Double Slash - Blast [爆], Reloading Tiantui Star's Blade
Below 80% HP or automatically at the end of the fourth Turn, Lei Heng recovers from Stagger and begins using the following Skill rotation:
- Tanglecleaver [快刀亂麻]
- Blasting Shatterslash [爆碎斬], Triple Slash - Blast [爆], Triple Slash - Blast [爆], Double Slash - Blast [爆], Double Slash - Blast [爆], Double Slash - Blast [爆], Reloading Tiantui Star's Blade
- Blasting Shatterslash [爆碎斬], Triple Slash - Blast [爆], Triple Slash - Blast [爆], Double Slash - Blast [爆], Double Slash - Blast [爆], Double Slash - Blast [爆], Reloading Tiantui Star's Blade

Below 60% HP or before using 'Tanglecleaver [快刀亂麻]' for the second time in the Encounter, Lei Heng recovers from Stagger and reloads his weapon. From that point on, he will only gain [Tigermark Round] while not having any [Savage Tigermark Round] at the end of the Turn, but whenever Lei Heng runs out of [Savage Tigermark Round], he will summon two special Stern Soldato of the Thumb on the next Turn, which will attempt to reload his ammo before retreating from battle at the end of the Turn.

Below 40% HP or after using 'Tanglecleaver [快刀亂麻]' for the third time in the Encounter, Lei Heng recovers from Stagger, resets his Skill rotation to the beginning, and replaces all instances of 'Tanglecleaver [快刀亂麻]' with 'Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades [超絕猛虎殺擊亂斬]'.

At the end of the Turn after being reduced below 20% HP (847 HP), a cutscene will be triggered, resulting in the player's victory. Lei Heng cannot be reduced below 10% HP (423 HP). The cutscene will activate even if the player would normally lose due to every selected Sinner being dead, assuming Lei Heng hit his HP threshold while there were still living Sinners.
